# Hybrid and Diffusion Representations
## Overview
Hybrid and Diffusion Representations address the challenge of synthesizing [3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)](#1174-3d-gaussian-splatting-3dgs.md) representations from single images or text prompts without iterative optimization, thereby amortizing reconstruction costs and enabling near-real-time sampling [S1]. This family distinguishes itself from sibling methods like [Adaptive Gaussian Refinement](11448-adaptive-gaussian-refinement.md) by decoupling spatial structure generation from attribute encoding via parallel decoders or by leveraging learned diffusion priors to solve multi-view inconsistency and spurious geometry issues [S1].

## Subtopics

### [TriplaneGaussian](7558-triplanegaussian.md)
[TriplaneGaussian](#7558-triplanegaussian.md) is a feed-forward method that generates 3DGS from a single input image by decoupling the generation of spatial structure (point cloud) and attribute encoding (tri-plane) via parallel transformer-based decoders. It leverages the geometric regularity of a tri-plane to encode Gaussian attributes, improving fidelity and consistency compared to point-cloud-only approaches.

### [GaussianDiffusion](9190-gaussiandiffusion.md)
[GaussianDiffusion](#9190-gaussiandiffusion.md) trains a 3D [diffusion model](#10443-diffusion-models-ddpms.md) based on a GaussianCube representation to synthesize 3D Gaussian fields directly. It solves the "Janus problem" (multi-view inconsistency) and spurious geometry ("floaters") by incorporating structured noises from multiple viewpoints and using variational 3DGS principles.

### Text2Immersion
#### definition
- [S1] A scene generation method similar to LucidDreamer but with outlier removal and two-stage optimization.
#### step
- [S1] A process removes outliers in the point cloud.
- [S1] 3DGS optimization has two stages: training coarse 3DGS and refinement.
